messages:
eric: Quick perf note — on a subset of Llama3-13B runs I observed tail latency jump ~20% after the recent kernel-selector tweak. Putting raw profile below, we should debug before we promote the change. :eyes:

maya: Ack, can you share the exact workload shape? long system prompts or many short chats?

eric: It's biased towards long system+context (chat template 'long_system'). Repro was with mixed seq lengths — average ~300 but bursts to 512. Profiling snippet: 
```
Profiler: selected_kernel=mm_optimized_q8 -> fallback=mm_generic
model=llama3-13b head_dim=96 num_heads=96 (per config)
seq_len=128 batch=8 -> 48ms/token (baseline 39ms)
KV cache: hit_rate=0.83 evictions=12 memcpy_time=6.2ms
```:warning:

maya: head_dim 96 should be supported; selector rule that picks optimized kernels currently gates on (head_dim % 64 == 0). That explains fallback. Did we ship new 96 kernels?

zhou: We built 96-optimized kernels upstream but the runtime feature flag rollout only flipped in staging (deploy-1678). Prod pools still using the older selector table. perf-bot confirmed staging-only rollout.

eric: There's a second interaction — the batch-slicer heuristic is aggressively microbatching when avg_seq_len > 200. With chat templates that prepend long system prompts the slicer splits heterogeneous batches, causing partial KV fills and extra memcpy/evictions. Combined with fallback kernel this amplifies tail latency.

maya: Can you paste the minimal repro command you used?

eric: Repro CLI: 
```
# repro that hits bad path
redwood-run --model llama3-13b --seq 512 --batch 16 --chat-template long_system --quant q8_0
```

zhou: Proposed fixes: (1) enable 96-optimized kernel entries in the selector table for the affected GPU arch; (2) change batch-slicer to consider current_kv_hit_rate and avoid slicing if hit_rate > 0.7; (3) reduce rope_theta default scaling for long_system template to avoid extra prefix computations that increase mem pressure.

sree: I've added perf board TODOs and can kick off a canary once we have a runtime build. Also we should validate RMSNorm/SiLU fusion kernels — different norm/activation combos pick different fused kernels and we saw an extra memcpy in the SiLU path in the trace.

devex: If we change selector semantics expose `kernel_selector.strategy` in the SDK so ops teams can opt in/out per pool. Also add a short mention in the release notes about potential latency improvements/regressions.

eric: Plan of attack: 
  1) flip the 96-kernel flag in a small canary pool (maya to own)
  2) land batch-slicer guard (zhou) — new rule: skip slicing when kv_hit_rate >= 0.7 OR when >50% of batch elements have seq_len > 256
  3) run 24h A/B perf job and collect traces; if stable promote globally.

maya: I'll own the canary, run with `--canary_pool=canary-gpu-small` and upload flamegraphs to the perf board.

zhou: I'll prepare the selector patch and add unit tests covering head_dim 64/96/128 cases. Also will add metric emission for `kernel_choice` per request.

perf-bot: Created perf-issue #421: "llama3 head-dim kernel fallback + batch-slicer perf regression" and scheduled 24h canary job.

maya: Thanks — will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

eric: One more note — watch for KV cache eviction spikes during the canary; if evictions exceed baseline by >10 we should revert batch-slicer change.

zhou: Agreed. I'll add a guard to auto-rollback the slicer tweak if evictions spike.

sree: Marking action items on board and assigning owners.

maya: ping me if anyone needs logs from the canary nodes, I have SSH access.

eric: Great, thanks everyone.
